name: price-matrix
title: Price matrix
description: A price grid for made-to-order products: sizes down, materials or quantities across, every price a radio in one group, the chosen row and column quietly marked.
docs: rows and columns are { id, label }; prices is a map by row id and then column id of an amount in minor units (1450 is 14.50), where null or a missing entry means the combination is not offered. Every price that is offered is a radio in one radiogroup named 'A3, 250 g paper, 14.50' (row, column, price), so one choice works with the arrow keys and Space: left and right move along a row, up and down along a column, past combinations that are not offered, and Home and End go to the ends of the row (with Ctrl, of the grid). A combination that is not offered says 'Not available' and cannot be picked. Control the choice with value and onValueChange(value, amount), where value is { row, column } or null, or leave it to defaultValue. The row and the column of the choice are quietly emphasised, markCheapest (on by default) writes 'Lowest price' on the cheapest combination, and the chosen price repeats under the grid in a polite status. The grid shows plain numbers in tabular figures and the currency is said once, in the caption, after your own caption text. Below the container width of 42rem the grid becomes one list per row, with the same radios, and the arrows walk the options in the order they are read. title names the group; without it labels.group does. Always pass locale; labels holds every word, the corner of the grid included.
